cards.title: Sleep routine support
cards.summary: Use regular cues and reduced friction without treating insomnia as a moral failure.
cards.when_to_use: Sleep timing is inconsistent or bedtime tasks are hard.
steps: Make bedtime tasks visible and low-friction.
Reduce stimulating tasks near intended sleep when feasible.
Keep wake time/routine as consistent as realistic.
Discuss persistent or severe sleep problems with a clinician.

cards.title: Nightmare aftercare
cards.summary: Reorient after a nightmare and reduce immediate arousal.
cards.when_to_use: After waking from a distressing dream.
steps: Use light or sensory input if helpful.
Track recurrent nightmares for clinician/therapy discussion if they are impairing.
